title: Two Cute Toddler Girls Playing Outdoors on Lawn, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet black-and-white candid snapshot captured in August 1956 showing two young toddler girls sitting together on the grass in a sunny backyard. One child gazes at the camera while the other turns toward her companion beside a large striped play ball. The photo reflects the quintessential mid-century American suburban family life and the post-war baby boom era, framed with decorative scalloped deckle edges and a classic timestamp on the upper white border.
